name: Intercompany Transaction Tracker
query:
SELECT
    si.name AS "Ecofinit Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:180",
    pi.name AS "Metal Green Purchase:Link/Purchase Invoice:180",
    sii.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:160",
    sii.qty AS "Qty:Float:100",
    sii.amount AS "Value:Currency:120",
    CASE
        WHEN si.docstatus = 1 AND pi.docstatus = 1 THEN 'Completed'
        WHEN si.docstatus = 1 AND pi.name IS NULL THEN 'Pending Purchase Invoice'
        WHEN si.docstatus = 2 OR pi.docstatus = 2 THEN 'Cancelled'
        ELSE 'Draft'
    END AS "Status:Data:120"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
    ON sii.parent = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice` pi
    ON pi.inter_company_invoice_reference = si.name
WHERE
    si.company = 'Ecofinit Dubai'
    AND si.customer = 'Metal Green Saudi Arabia - Internal Customer'
ORDER BY si.creation DESC
